info.title: RustyFlows API
info.description:
AI Workflow Orchestration Framework — OpenAPI specification.

All authenticated endpoints require a Bearer JWT token via the `Authorization` header.

post.description:
Body: `WorkflowRunReq`
- Provide either `workflow` (inline) or `workflow_id` (DB lookup; currently unsupported).
- `input`: primary input string for the workflow.
- `variables` (optional): key/value map for templating and routing.
- `provider_params` (optional): per-call LLM config.
- `bearer_token`: Supabase session JWT used for REST access.

Returns JSON string: final workflow output or error.

202.description: Workflow is waiting on a gate

post.description:
Body: `WorkflowRunReq`
This endpoint always streams events for each step, where possible.
See event schema in response below.

Events (JSON):
- {"type":"meta","provider":"workflow","workflow":"<name|inline>"}
- {"type":"meta","provider":"<llm>","endpoint":"...","model":"..."}    // forwarded from prompt steps
- {"type":"delta","content":"..."}                                     // incremental tokens
- {"type":"message","content":"...","step":"map|router|parallel"}      // synthetic step messages
- {"type":"final","content":"..."}                                     // final workflow text
- {"type":"error","message":"..."}                                     // on errors
- {"type":"done"}

AgentFullRow.description: Full agent row including model_id and timestamps (for single-agent fetch).

AgentInsert.description: Insert payload for creating an agent.

organization_id.description: Tenant organization ID — set server-side from auth context.

AgentUpdate.description: Partial update payload for agents (all fields optional).

AttachmentBinding.description: Binds attachments from a named step output into the template context.

bind_to.description: Field name in the template context to bind these attachments to.

from.description: Source: which step's attachments to include (step name).

mime_filter.description: Filter by mime type prefix (e.g., "image/" for all images).

AvailableAgent.description: An agent available to the Supervisor for delegation.

description.description:
Optional description override (used in the tool definition shown to the supervisor).
Falls back to the agent's DB description if not set.

CheckpointMode.description: Checkpoint mode for workflow run tracking and resume support.

oneOf.description: A literal value.
Reference an existing column.
Arithmetic on two sub-expressions.
Concatenate string parts.
If-then-else based on a filter condition.

ComparisonOp.description: Comparison operators for expression-based routing conditions.

Condition.description: Conditional execution configuration for any step.

template.description: Template expression that should evaluate to "true" to execute the step.

oneOf.description: Keep only the specified columns.
Filter rows by a boolean expression.
Sort rows by one or more columns.
Limit the number of rows returned.
Rename columns.
Remove duplicate rows (optionally on specific columns).
Group by columns and compute aggregates.
Add a computed column.
Join with another named output.
Pivot (long → wide): spread a column's values into new columns.
Unpivot (wide → long): gather columns into key-value rows.
Cast a column to a different type.

DataOp.description: A single data operation in a DataOp pipeline.

DataOpStep.description:
Step: Declarative tabular data manipulation via Polars DataFrames.

Converts a JSON array to a DataFrame, applies a pipeline of operations
(filter, sort, aggregate, join, etc.), and converts back to JSON.

from.description: Named output to use as input source (default: ctx.current()).

name.description: Optional name for the output (referenced by later steps as {{name}}).

operations.description: Pipeline of operations applied sequentially to the DataFrame.

DeleteResponse.description: Generic success message (used for delete responses).

Environment.description: A row from `control_plane.environments` — a named, org-scoped deployment target.

organization_id.description: Tenant organization ID. `None` for platform-level environments.

EnvironmentInsert.description: Insert payload for creating an environment.

organization_id.description: Tenant organization ID — set server-side from auth context.

oneOf.description: Apply a filter expression; matches if any rows remain.
Compare the DataFrame row count against a threshold.
Compute an aggregate on a column and compare against a threshold.

ExpressionCondition.description: A condition evaluated against tabular data for expression routing.

FanOutErrorPolicy.description: Error policy for FanOut step when a branch fails.

FanOutStep.description:
Step: Fan out over a dynamic runtime array with concurrent branch execution.

Takes an array produced at runtime (e.g., from a Generate step) and processes
each item concurrently through branch workflows, with optional grouping support.

group_var.description: Variable name for the group key in branch context (default: "group").

index_var.description: Variable name for the current index in branch context (default: "index").

item_var.description: Variable name for the current item in branch context (default: "item").

max_concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent branches (None = unlimited).

name.description: Optional name for the combined output (referenced by later steps as {{name}}).

path.description: Optional JSON path into the source value to extract the array.

source.description: Source of the array (named output, "last", or "input"). Supports template variables.

oneOf.description: One branch per item, all using the same template workflow.
Group items by a key field and route each group to a different branch workflow.

Group items by a tags field (array of strings) and run matching branches for each tag.
An item can produce multiple branches if it has multiple matching tags.

FanOutStrategy.description: Strategy for distributing items across branches in a FanOut step.

oneOf.description: Single comparison condition.
Logical AND of sub-expressions.
Logical OR of sub-expressions.
Logical NOT of a sub-expression.

GateStep.description: Step: Pause the workflow and wait for human input before continuing.

metadata.description: Optional metadata to attach to the gate record.

name.description: Optional name for the result (lets later steps reference the gate response).

options.description: Required for Select gates: the options to choose from.

prompt.description: Prompt to display to the user (supports {{input}}, {{last}}, etc.).

timeout_seconds.description: Optional timeout, in seconds, after which the gate is eligible for expiry handling.

GateTimeoutAction.description: Default action to apply when a gate expires.

GenerateStep.description:
Step: Use an LLM to produce structured JSON output.

Supports agent resolution (inline or DB), optional JSON schema validation,
retry logic for malformed responses, and conversation memory.

agent_id.description: UUID of the agent to invoke (mutually exclusive with `agent`).

exclude_mcp_servers.description:
MCP servers to exclude from tool resolution for this step.
By default all MCP servers are available; list server names here to opt-out.

image_urls.description:
Optional list of image URLs to include with the generation prompt (for vision models).
Can use template variables like "{{attachment_0}}" or "{{optimized_image}}".

include_attachments.description: If true, automatically include all image attachments from the workflow request.

inline_tools.description:
Inline tool definitions — built-in tools configured directly on the step.
These are synthesized into ToolRows at execution time (no DB lookup).

input_template.description: Optional input template (may reference {{input}}, {{last}}, named outputs, etc.).

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts if JSON parsing/validation fails (default 0).

memory.description: Explicit opt-in to use conversation memory for this step (default off).

memory_record_original_input.description: If true, record the original user input (ctx.initial_input) instead of step_input when writing to memory.

memory_window_messages.description: Optional memory window by count of messages to include when memory is enabled.

memory_window_tokens.description: Optional memory window by token budget to include when memory is enabled.

name.description: Optional name for the result (lets later steps reference this output by name).

schema.description:
Optional JSON schema describing the expected output structure.
Used for basic type validation (array/object/string) of the LLM response.

tool_agent_ids.description:
Optional "agent tools" represented as agent ids (agent-as-tool).
When provided, the target agent may use these tool agents to fulfill the request.

GovernedWorkflowPackage.description:
SDK/CLI-authored package that wraps the runtime workflow IR with governance
metadata. Backend runtime paths should unwrap `workflow` before execution.

display_name.description: Optional display name for UI surfaces.

name.description: Stable package name used by SDKs, CLI, and deployment records.

policy_refs.description: Referenced policy names in `resources.policies` or tenant policy catalogs.

ruleset_refs.description: Referenced ruleset names in `resources.rulesets` or tenant rule catalogs.

schema_version.description: Version of the governed package schema, independent of app or DB schema versions.

data.description: Transform an image with flexible size and quality settings.

format.description: Target format: "jpeg", "png", "webp" (optional - if not specified, keeps original format).

data.description:
Optimize image for LLM vision models with a simple detail level setting.
This is a convenience operation that combines resize + compress with optimal settings.

detail.description:
Target detail level: "low", "high", or "auto".
- "low": 512px max, quality 80, optimized for token efficiency
- "high": 2048px max, quality 90, optimized for detail
- "auto": Analyzes image and picks appropriate settings

ImageProcessOp.description: Image processing operations for preprocessing images before vision models.

ImageProcessStep.description: Step: Preprocess images before sending to vision-capable LLMs.

name.description: Optional name to store the result in named_outputs.

source.description:
Source of the image:
- "attachment:N" (0-4) to reference an attachment by index
- "{{variable}}" to use a template variable containing a URL
- "last" to use the output of the previous step

ImageQuality.description: Image quality settings for lossy compression.

level.description:
Quality level 1-100 (higher = better quality, larger file).
Default: 85

optimize.description:
Whether to apply additional optimization (e.g., strip metadata, optimize encoding).
Default: false

value.description: Absolute dimensions in pixels (maintains aspect ratio, fits within bounds).

ImageSize.description: Image size specification - supports absolute dimensions, percentage scale, or presets.

ImageSizePreset.description: Preset image sizes for common scenarios.

InlineAgentConfig.description:
Inline agent configuration — define model/provider/system_prompt directly in the workflow
JSON instead of referencing a DB-stored agent by id.

InlineToolSpec.description:
An inline tool definition — embedded directly in a workflow step's JSON
rather than referencing a DB-stored tool by id.

description.description: Optional description (helps the LLM choose when to invoke the tool).

name.description: Display name for the tool (shown to the LLM).

spec.description:
Tool spec in the same format as `ToolRow.spec`
(contains `kind`, `input_schema`, and kind-specific fields).

KnowledgeOutputFormat.description: Output format for knowledge retrieval results.

KnowledgeSearchMode.description:
Search mode for knowledge retrieval. Used by both the workflow `KnowledgeStep`
(in `workflow::knowledge`) and the data layer's `KnowledgeDb::knowledge_search`
trait method, so it lives at the contracts boundary.

KnowledgeStep.description:
Step: Vector similarity search against one or more knowledge sources.

Embeds a query, searches pgvector, and formats results for downstream consumption
(typically injected into a Prompt step's context). The embedding model is determined
by the source config, ensuring queries match the stored chunk embeddings.

excluded_tags.description: Excluded tags — none may be present on matching chunks.

include_metadata.description: Include chunk metadata in output (default: false).

knowledge_base_ids.description:
Knowledge base IDs — resolved to source_ids at runtime.
When a KB is referenced, ALL its current sources are included in the search.

name.description: Optional name for the output (referenced by later steps as {{name}}).

query_template.description:
Template for the search query (supports {{input}}, {{last}}, named outputs).
Falls back to the current context value ({{last}} or {{input}}) if not set.

required_tags.description: Required tags — all must be present on matching chunks.

source_ids.description: Knowledge source IDs to search (supports multi-source queries).

top_k.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5).

vector_weight.description: Weight for vector vs text results in hybrid mode (0.0 = text only, 1.0 = vector only, default: 0.5).

LogicalResourceRef.description:
A package-local resource reference that may be unresolved, selector-based,
or already resolved to a concrete runtime id.

external_id.description: Provider or external system identifier used during resolution.

metadata.description: Optional selector metadata for provider-specific matching.

name.description: Human-readable target name used during resolution.

required.description: Whether validation/deploy should fail if this resource cannot resolve.

data.description: Template that should evaluate to "true" or "false".

LoopStep.description: Step: Loop over items or repeat N times.

name.description: Optional name for the combined output.

data.description: Iterate over items in an array from a named output or current value.

index_var.description: Variable name to use for current index in loop body (default: "index").

item_var.description: Variable name to use for current item in loop body (default: "item").

path.description: Optional JSON path to extract array from source.

source.description: Source of the array (named output or "last" or "input").

index_var.description: Variable name to use for current iteration number (default: "index").

data.description: While condition is true (evaluated via template or agent).

max_iterations.description: Maximum iterations to prevent infinite loops.

data.description:
Apply a string template to form the next value.
Variables like {{input}} and named step outputs may be substituted at runtime.

Extract a portion of JSON from a source string using a simple path.

- `from`: Optional name of a prior named output; if omitted, uses the current value.
- `path`: Dot path with optional array indexes like `data`, `data[0]`, `data[0].field`.

MapOp.description: Mapping operations for simple deterministic transforms (no LLM call).

name.description: Optional name for the result (lets later steps reference this output by name).

MathOp.description: Arithmetic operators for Math column expressions.

oneOf.description: Build a final string from a template. Branch outputs may be referenced by index or name.

ParallelStep.description: Step: Run multiple branches in parallel and optionally reduce their results.

PolicyEffect.description: Policy effect - what happens when policy triggers.

PolicyIR.description: Governance policy IR stored in control plane.

PolicyScope.description: Policy scope - where the policy applies.

PolicyTrigger.description: Policy trigger - when the policy activates.

PromptStep.description: Step: Invoke an Agent by id (from Supabase agents table) or via inline config.

agent_id.description: UUID of the agent to invoke (mutually exclusive with `agent`).

exclude_mcp_servers.description:
MCP servers to exclude from tool resolution for this step.
By default all MCP servers are available; list server names here to opt-out.

image_source.description:
Optional reference to a named output containing attachments for image URLs.
Looks up ctx.named_outputs[source], extracts .attachments[] array,
and includes image URLs in the prompt.

image_urls.description:
Optional list of image URLs to include with the prompt (for vision models).
Can use template variables like "{{attachment_0}}" or "{{optimized_image}}".

include_attachments.description: If true, automatically include all attachments from the workflow request.

inline_tools.description:
Inline tool definitions — built-in tools configured directly on the step.
These are synthesized into ToolRows at execution time (no DB lookup).

input_template.description:
Optional input template. If provided, may reference variables or prior step outputs.
For example: "Summarize: {{input}}" or "Add 1000 to {{last}}".

knowledge_source_ids.description:
Optional knowledge source IDs for auto-RAG context injection.
When set, the step automatically retrieves relevant chunks and prepends them to the input.

knowledge_top_k.description: Maximum chunks to retrieve for auto-RAG (default: 3).

memory.description: Explicit opt-in to use conversation memory for this step (default off).

memory_record_original_input.description:
If true, record the original user input (ctx.initial_input) instead of step_input when writing to memory.
This is useful for the first step (e.g., Intent Classifier) that should record the clean user message.

memory_window_messages.description: Optional memory window by count of messages to include when memory is enabled.

memory_window_tokens.description: Optional memory window by token budget to include when memory is enabled.

name.description: Optional name for the result (lets later steps reference this output by name).

tool_agent_ids.description:
Optional "agent tools" represented as agent ids (agent-as-tool).
When provided, the target agent may use these tool agents to fulfill the request.

ProviderParams.description:
Optional per-call provider configuration.
Not all fields are used by every provider.

ReportGenerateData.description:
Step: Generate a structured report from a template.

Resolves a template (stored or inline), builds a context from workflow state,
and renders via the restricted Handlebars engine.

context.description:
Maps template field keys to workflow template expressions.
Each value is resolved using the standard `apply_template()` engine.

include_attachments.description: Optional: include attachments from referenced step outputs.

include_content_in_output.description:
Whether to include the full rendered content in the step output JSON.

When `false`, only metadata (report_id, filename, download_url) is included.
Set to `false` when `upload_to_storage` is `true` to avoid large payloads
in webhook callbacks, chat responses, and downstream template variables.
Defaults to `true` for backward compatibility.

inline_template.description: Inline template content (Markdown + Handlebars). Mutually exclusive with `template_id`.

name.description: Required human-friendly name for the step output.

template_id.description: UUID of a stored report template (mutually exclusive with `inline_template`).

template_version.description: Pin to a specific template version. If omitted, uses the latest active version.

upload_to_storage.description: Whether to upload the rendered document to tenant storage (Phase 2).

RerankConfig.description: Configuration for LLM-based reranking of search results.

top_n.description: Number of results to keep after reranking (default: same as top_k).

backoff_multiplier.description: Exponential backoff multiplier (e.g., 2.0 means double delay each time).

retry_on_error_pattern.description: Only retry on specific error patterns (regex).

RouterCase.description: A router case using literal matching.

RouterExpressionCase.description: A router case using data expression evaluation.

RouterRegexCase.description: A router case using regex matching.

pattern.description: A regular expression pattern to test.

RouterStep.description:
Step: Route to one of several branches.
A router may choose a branch using literal matching, regex, or by delegating
to a classifier agent.

data.description: Match the latest value (or a named variable) by literal string equality.
Match using regular expressions (first match wins).
Ask a classifier agent to return a label; route based on that label.

cases.description: Cases mapping classifier labels to branches.

data.description: Evaluate data conditions against tabular/JSON output from the previous step.

RouterStrategy.description: Strategies for selecting a branch in a router step.

RulesetIR.description: Business ruleset IR stored in control plane.

RuntimeTarget.description: Runtime target hint for a governed workflow package.

RuntimeTargetHints.description:
Non-authoritative execution target hints. Validation and deployment decide
whether a target is actually available for an organization/environment.

StepResumePolicy.description: Resume policy for an interrupted top-level workflow step.

StreamingStrategy.description:
Streaming strategy for parallel step execution.
Determines how branch results are streamed to the client.

SupervisorStep.description:
Step: A meta-agent that dynamically plans and delegates tasks to specialist agents.

The supervisor agent only gets agent-tools (no DB tools) — clean separation
of planner vs executor. It dynamically decides which agents to call and when
the task is complete.

exclude_mcp_servers.description:
MCP servers to exclude from tool resolution for this step.
By default all MCP servers are available; list server names here to opt-out.

planning_prompt.description: Optional planning prompt appended to the supervisor agent's system prompt.

SystemPromptFullRow.description: Full system prompt row including content and timestamps.

SystemPromptInsert.description: Insert payload for creating a system prompt.

organization_id.description: Tenant organization ID — set server-side from auth context.

SystemPromptList.description: Minimal info for listing prompts for UX/debug.

SystemPromptUpdate.description: Partial update payload for system prompts (all fields optional).

ToolFullRow.description: Full tool row including timestamps (for single-tool fetch/edit).

ToolInsert.description: Insert payload for creating a tool.

organization_id.description: Tenant organization ID — set server-side from auth context.

ToolListRow.description: Summary row for tool list (no spec for lighter payloads).

ToolStep.description: Step: Execute a registered tool (spec-driven, e.g. HTTP).

params_template.description: Optional params template that renders to JSON passed to the tool executor.

tool_id.description: UUID of the tool row in agent_factory.tools

ToolUpdate.description: Partial update payload for tools (all fields optional).

Workflow.description:
-------- Dynamic Workflow Types for Agentic Pipelines --------
A workflow is a sequence of steps that can include prompt calls, mapping, routing,
and parallel branches.

name.description: Optional human-friendly name for the workflow (useful when stored in DB).

steps.description:
Steps executed in order, unless a router or parallel step alters control flow.
May be empty when `workflow_id` is set (steps are loaded from DB during resolution).

workflow_id.description:
Optional reference to a stored workflow by id.
When set, the workflow's steps are loaded from the DB during resolution.
Can be used in parallel branches, loop bodies, and router branches.

WorkflowAttachmentRequest.description: Attachment object accepted by workflow execution endpoints.

WorkflowCompatibility.description:
Compatibility metadata carried with packages so SDKs, CLIs, and backend
validators can make version decisions before deployment or execution.

WorkflowFullRow.description: Full workflow row including node_positions for the editor.

default_test_account_id.description: Default BYO test account for runs of this workflow.

system_id.description: The system this workflow belongs to.

visual_nodes.description: Visual-only canvas metadata (e.g., reroute waypoints). Opaque JSON blob owned by the frontend.

WorkflowInsert.description: Insert payload for creating a workflow.

organization_id.description: Tenant organization ID — set server-side from auth context.

WorkflowListRow.description: Summary row for workflow list (excludes node_positions for lighter payloads).

default_test_account_id.description: Default BYO test account for runs of this workflow.

expose_as_mcp.description: Whether this workflow is exposed as an MCP tool (default: false).

system_id.description: The system this workflow belongs to.

WorkflowPackageResources.description: Logical resource maps keyed by package-local names such as `invoice-parser`.

WorkflowRunRequest.description:
Request body for workflow execution endpoints.

This mirrors the public, serialized subset of `WorkflowRunReq`. Runtime-only
fields such as tenant context, HTTP clients, and email services are injected
server-side and are intentionally absent from the API contract.

input.description: Primary input string for the workflow.

system_id.description: System override for this run. If omitted, the workflow System then org default System is used.

test_account_id.description: BYO test account override for this run.

use_memory.description: Whether memory-aware steps may use conversation history.

workflow_id.description: Saved workflow id to execute. Provide this or `workflow`.

WorkflowStep.description: A single step within a workflow.

WorkflowUpdate.description: Partial update payload for workflows (all fields optional).
